name: MX AI
summary: Shopify app that plays a track of your choice in the background of a storefront, with control over the player's colour, size, position, volume, loop and autoplay, and sources ranging from an uploaded MP3 to Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music and YouTube formats. Built for Shopify, live since January 2020.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want seasonal or ambient audio on the storefront, want a say in how the player looks and behaves, and would rather use the app's royalty-free tracks than sort out the licensing for a song of their own
skip_if: you only need a single uploaded MP3 looping in the background, because RoarTheme's free app covers exactly that; or your store competes on load speed and accessibility, where unexpected audio is a liability; or you have never measured whether sound moves your conversion rate, because the listing offers no evidence that it does
honest_knock:
The strongest argument against paying for this is one App Store search away. RT: Background Music Player, from RoarTheme, does the core job (upload a media file, it plays in the background) and the listing prices it at Free, full stop. It sits at 4.8 stars over 72 reviews against this app's 4.8 over 66, and it has been on the store since 5 February 2021. What the $4.99 buys over free is real but narrow: control over the player's colour, size, position, volume, loop and autoplay, sources beyond an uploaded file, and a set of AI-generated royalty-free seasonal tracks. If all you want is one MP3 looping on the homepage, you are paying for controls you will set once and never open again.

Two smaller things worth knowing before you install. The "Free plan available" badge on the listing is for development and partner stores only: on a live store there is no free tier, so read that badge as a 7-day trial. And the pitch that background music "can enhance your interaction with customers and improve conversion rate & sales" arrives with no evidence: no study, no store data, no test. Autoplay is not entirely yours to command either, because browsers block audio that starts without a user gesture, so the autoplay switch takes effect once the shopper has interacted with the page rather than on load. At $4.99 the cost of finding out whether sound helps your store is small, but find out, rather than assume.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Monthly Plan · per month for the whole app, with no usage tier above it
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/custom-background-music and in our own test that day; earlier: read 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-03, re-read 2026-11-13 on apps.shopify.com/custom-background-music; the price rose between the October and November readings) Two plans, and the free one is not for you. Development Stores is free with unlimited access to every feature, but the listing restricts it to development and partner stores and says payment is activated on upgrade. A live store runs on the Monthly Plan: $4.99 a month, or $29.94 a year paid up front, which the listing labels a 50% saving (it was $2.99 and $25.12 on 16 September and 3 October 2026). Both are billed in USD every 30 days, and the paid plan opens with a 7-day free trial. The pricing block lists nothing above the Monthly Plan — no traffic tier, no play-count tier, no second paid step — so $4.99 is the whole app whether the storefront sees ten visitors a day or ten thousand. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing still shows the Development Stores plan and the Monthly Plan at $4.99 a month or $29.94 a year with a 7 day trial, now at 4.8 from 70 reviews. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the app did not offer the Development Stores plan: it opened on “Pick your plan to start a 7 days free trial”, with a Yearly Plan at $2.50 a month billed annually, marked “SALE: Save 50%”, and a Monthly Plan that the app labelled $0.00 a month. Shopify's approval screen for the Monthly Plan showed $4.99 every 30 days after a 7 day trial ending 24 November, and the annual plan $29.94 every year, each with an Add payment method row and no line saying the charge would not be billed. So the $0.00 on the app's card is not what Shopify charges, and we did not approve either plan. The app notes that each store gets at most 7 trial days altogether.

schema_offer.description: Monthly Plan, per month for the whole app, with no usage tier above it; $29.94 a year is the same plan paid up front (it was 2.99 and 25.12 until October 2026). Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-17.

compare_with.name: RT: Background Music Player
compare_with.why: Same job, and the competitor's price is zero. RoarTheme's RT: Background Music Player plays an uploaded media file in the background, lets you limit it to the homepage or run it on every public page, keeps working on mobile browsers, and resumes playback at the point the shopper left off: all on a plan the listing prices at Free. It rates 4.8 over 72 reviews and has been live since 5 February 2021, against MX AI's 4.8 over 66 and a January 2020 launch. The $4.99 a month buys three things RT does not list: control over the player's colour, size, position, volume, loop and autoplay; sources beyond an uploaded file, including Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music and YouTube formats; and a library of AI-generated royalty-free seasonal songs. Worth paying for if you will use the design controls or the track library. If not, start with the free one and keep the $60 a year ($30 on the annual plan).

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session installed MX AI (MX Background Music in the admin) on a Shopify development store. The app opened on a plan choice where the Monthly Plan said $0.00/month, but the Shopify approval screen asked $4,99 every 30 days and a payment method, so no music player was tested. The app was uninstalled; nothing was paid. Install: the install form was sent at about 22:34; the dialog Install app for MX Background Music by Effective Apps asked for View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Online Store, Shopify admin); Install was clicked at about 22:36. The app opened on Welcome to MX AI: Background Music Player. Core action NOT DONE: the app shows only the plan screen and no dashboard without a plan. No song was chosen and no player was seen in the store. Plans in the app: Yearly Plan $2.50/month billed annually (SALE: Save 50%) and Monthly Plan $0.00/month billed monthly; each store gets at most 7 trial days altogether. No Development plan was offered. Checkout: Start free trial on the Monthly Plan opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov, subtotal and total $4,99, due 24 Nov, $4,99 USD every 30 days, the row Add payment method and a disabled Approve button. The line You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen. The annual plan screen showed $29,94 USD every year, total $29,94, also with Add payment method. After Cancel a red message said The shop cannot accept the provided charge. Nothing was approved and no card was entered. Difference: the app card says Monthly $0.00/month, while Shopify charges $4,99 every 30 days; Yearly $2.50/month equals $29,94 a year. Cancelling: no subscription existed. The uninstall dialog Uninstall MX Background Music? warns that data managed by the app will be deleted and needs a reason (Testing multiple apps). Clean up: the app was uninstalled (You've successfully uninstalled MX Background Music); no theme change. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Monthly card in the app says $0.00/month while Shopify asks $4,99 every 30 days; the app shows nothing before a plan is approved, the approval screen needed a payment method and had no test charge line, and Cancel showed an error.
